BiblicalUsage: White linen is the cloth of the palace, and the court of Ahasuerus hangs white and blue curtains for the king's feast. Mordecai leaves the king's presence in royal apparel of blue and white, and the linen marks the honour of the moment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe white linen in Esther shows how quickly God can turn a death sentence into a royal procession.
